attañjaho.g: “etaṁ mamā”ti taṇhāgahaṇavasena ca diṭṭhigahaṇavasena ca parāmasitvā gahitaṁ, parato āmaṭṭhañca, tasmiṁ abhiniviṭṭhañca, balavataṇhāvasena gilitvā ajjhositañca, balavamucchitañca.
